label: Preliminary Finals
sources: afl.com.au 'Medical room: the full AFL injury list, FW3'
source_note: The afl.com.au fetch returned the HAWTHORN and GEELONG blocks transposed (it listed Worpel/Stanley/Conway/Barker under Hawthorn — all Geelong 2026 players — and Nash/Reeves/Scrimshaw/Anderson under Geelong — all Hawthorn). Undoing the swap, it agrees with the local scraper on all four prelim clubs. Hawthorn's list below is the corrected one.
curation_rule: Only players whose absence is NOT already absorbed by the rating are given full weight. A player absent for many rounds with a settled replacement is downgraded a quality notch or dropped, and the reason is recorded in `excluded`. 'doubtful'/'test' players are recorded but are not 'out'.

Sydney Swans.note: Banned 2026-08-19 for the rest of the season. Missed 2 games (R23, QF). ELO built over 20+ games WITH him, so this is NOT yet absorbed by the rating.
Captain. Ruptured ACL late Q1 of the QF on 2026-09-05 — NEW this week; the rating has ~1 game of partial evidence only.
Reported likely to be available — NOT counted as out.

Fremantle Dockers.note: Downgraded from 'good' — missed the semi and Oscar McDonald has held the spot, so most of the loss is already in the rating.
Luke Jackson is the incumbent No.1 ruck — NOT counted as out.

Hawthorn Hawks.note: Downgraded from 'good' — long-term absence, fully absorbed by the rating.
Has not played a senior game since R8 — absence is entirely in the rating, so excluded from 'out' rather than double-counted.
Back-up ruck to Lloyd Meek; reported available for the prelim if required.

Sydney Swans: Max King (back, season) — depth, no senior role
Joel Amartey — reported fit and available
excluded.note: The five suspended Swans are deliberately INCLUDED at full weight. The Championship 'absentees already in the ratings' lesson does not transfer here: those ratings were fitted with zero appearances from the player, whereas Sydney's 1743 ELO was built across a full season WITH Heeney/Warner/Blakey and has been moved by only two subsequent games.
